$comment: Cross-language contract for cairn-plot's cross-face string enums (colormaps, HDR tone-map operators, public compare-kernel modes, compare view-modes/aligns/fits, and pixel-value notations) PLUS two mappings (the back-compat colormap alias table and the public-mode->kernel-id `diffSubmode` table) AND the shared builder-name set (the composable builders both faces expose). This ONE file is the canonical set; the TS sources are pinned to it by ui/src/lib/cairn-plot/contracts.test.ts + ui/src/lib/cairn-plot/builder/builders.test.ts and the Python side by tests/test_contracts.py. To change a set, edit this file AND both language sources — a single edit on either side fails its guard. Order is documentation only; every guard compares as a set (mappings compare key+value).
$comment_colormapAliases: Back-compat colormap ALIAS mapping (audit addendum D3): removed name -> canonical replacement. `viridis` was dropped when tev-mapped `turbo` became the default sequential map, so an incoming `viridis` resolves to `turbo` rather than erroring. ONE runtime source per face — Python `_COLORMAP_ALIASES` (components.py) <-> TS `COLORMAP_ALIASES` (colormaps/lut.ts, which `aliasColormap` and `image/encodings/registry.ts`'s `getEncoding` both delegate to). The guard checks KEY+VALUE; contracts.test.ts additionally asserts every alias target is a real colormap.
$comment_tonemapOperatorAliases: DEPRECATED pre-unification operator names, kept ACCEPTED as aliases resolving to a (canonical operator, peak) pair under the unified surface (PEAK is the mode; SDR = P=1): extended→linear+P=inf, extended-clamp→linear, extended-reinhard→reinhard, extended-aces→aces, extended-gamma→gamma.
$comment_compareKernelModes: The public `cp.Compare(mode=)` diff-name -> descriptor `diffSubmode` mapping, hand-mirrored by Python `_COMPARE_KERNEL_MODES` (components.py) and TS `COMPARE_KERNEL_MODES` (builder/validate.ts). Its KEYS == `compareKernelPublicNames` (both guards assert this). Its VALUES are the `diffSubmode` tokens the descriptor carries; contracts.test.ts additionally asserts every value resolves through `resolveDiffKernelId` + the kernel registry (`getDiffKernel`) for both u8 and float sources, so a registry kernel-id rename can no longer drift the tables silently (audit M6). Note `flip`/`flip_ldr` are MENU TOKENS, not kernel ids: they auto-dispatch client-side to `flip`/`hdr-flip`/`flip-ldr-forced`.
$comment_compareEnums: Compare view-compositions + mismatched-size operand handling (audit M5): `compareViewModes` = `cp.Compare(mode=)` non-diff views; `compareAligns`/`compareFits` = `cp.Compare(align=, fit=)`. Python `_COMPARE_VIEW_MODES`/`_COMPARE_ALIGNS`/`_COMPARE_FITS` (components.py) <-> TS `COMPARE_VIEW_MODES`/`COMPARE_ALIGNS`/`COMPARE_FITS` (builder/validate.ts).
$comment_pixelValueNotations: TEV pixel-value overlay notation kwarg (audit M5): Python `_PIXEL_VALUE_NOTATIONS` (components.py) <-> TS `PIXEL_VALUE_NOTATIONS` (builder/validate.ts). The rendering type union `PixelValueNotation` (primitives/PixelValueOverlay.tsx) is derived FROM that TS list (no third copy).
